school: 清初'以史家体例志怪'的民间写作体系构建者：以'异史氏曰'的论赞体给狐鬼花妖立史家名分，以花妖人格的非人视角照出人性之伪，以促织与席方平的小人物遭遇解剖大制度，以'情是常量、形是变量'的情本判例集重估身份界限，以喜剧外壳装载悲剧内核让真话走得最远，以规则颠倒的镜城安全而锋利地映射现实，以'闻则命笔'的三十年田野采集建成独特语料库，最终以'孤愤之书'把终身失意登记为作品的动力源——他是把一个落第者的一生做成精密批判装置的人
historical_significance: 蒲松龄（1640-1715），字留仙，一字剑臣，别号柳泉居士，世称聊斋先生，淄川人；十九岁应童子试，以县、府、道三试第一受知于施闰章，补博士弟子员；此后乡试屡试屡败四十四年，七十一岁始援例成为岁贡生；一生除南游作幕一年外，家居著述，在毕际有家坐馆三十年；《聊斋志异》凡四百九十余篇，以传奇法写志怪，篇末仿《史记》'太史公曰'自设'异史氏曰'论赞，借狐鬼花妖写科场、官府、市井，'写鬼写妖高人一等，刺贪刺虐入骨三分'（郭沫若语）；另有《聊斋文集》《聊斋诗集》《聊斋俚曲》及科普著作《农桑经》《药崇书》等；他证明：一个体制外落第者的终身失意，可以铸成一部精密、锋利、传世三百年的批判体系
historical_significance_en: Pu Songling (1640-1715), courtesy name Liuxian, also Jianchen, sobriquet Hermit of Liu Springs, known to the world as Master Liao Studio, a native of Zichuan; at nineteen he passed the novitiate examinations first of county, prefecture and circuit, noticed by Shi Runzhang; for forty-four years after he failed the provincial examination repeatedly, receiving at seventy-one by grace the title of annual tribute scholar; apart from one year as a secretary in the south he lived at home writing, thirty of those years tutoring in the house of Bi Jiyou; his Liao Studio records of the strange run to nearly five hundred tales, the method of chuanqi applied to zhiguai, each closed by remarks of 'the Historian of the Strange' in imitation of the Grand Historian, foxes, ghosts, flowers and demons set to anatomize the examination halls, the yamen and the streets — 'in writing ghosts and demons a grade above men, in stabbing greed and cruelty to the bone,' as Guo Moruo wrote; he left also prose, poems, folk-songs in the local verse, and works of husbandry and medicine; he proved: a lifelong failure outside the system can be cast into a precise, sharp and three-hundred-year critique
unique_thinking: 蒲松龄的独特处在于：他把'怪力乱神'处理成正史体例的严肃材料，为边缘经验争得与王侯将相同等的档案规格；他的批判从制度链条的最末端（一只蟋蟀、一个告状无门的乡下人）发起，让制度的重量在承受者身上显形；他重估了爱情与人格的资格常量——情是常量，形（容貌、身份、生死）是变量；他为弱者发明了完整的话语技术：体例借权（异史氏）、笑声藏刀（喜剧外壳）、规则颠倒（罗刹海市）、门外视角（入闱七似）
unique_thinking_en: Pu Songling's singularity: he handled 'the strange' as serious material in the historian's form, winning for marginal experience the archival grade of princes and generals; his critique launches from the far end of the institutional chain — a cricket, a villager with nowhere to appeal — letting the system's weight show in its bearer; he reweighed the qualification-constants of love and person — feeling the constant, form (looks, status, life and death) the variable; and he devised for the weak a complete technology of speech: borrowed form (the Historian of the Strange), the knife in laughter (comic shell), the inverted rule (the Luocha Kingdom), the view from outside the gate (the seven likenesses)
civilization_zh: 清初北方民间——科举制度成熟而僵化的时代，一个底层士人对制度的最深理解不是来自朝堂而是来自门外的四十四年凝视
civilization_en: The north-country folk of the early Qing — an age when the examination system was mature and rigid; one scholar of the lowest grade understood the system most deeply not from the court but from forty-four years of gazing from outside its gate
key_works: 《聊斋志异》（近五百篇志怪传奇集）
《聊斋自志》（'孤愤之书'的自述纲领）
《农桑经》《药崇书》（农学医药实用书）

cross_references.description_zh: 蒲松龄与汤显祖同为'以情为第一原理'的体系构建者，且都以虚构完成立法：汤显祖以'生者可以死，死可以生'为情立本体论，靠舞台与宜黄伶人传承；蒲松龄以'情是常量、形是变量'写出一部情本判例集（连城、香玉、娇娜），靠文本与论赞传承——同一件事（为'情'立法），一个做成戏剧体系，一个做成叙事判例；两人在'情对理的胜利'上同调，差异在汤向内在体验深处扎根，蒲向制度批判的锋面展开。
cross_references.description_en: Pu Songling and Tang Xianzu are both system-builders who take feeling as first principle, and both legislate through fiction: Tang founded an ontology for feeling — the living may die, the dead may live — carried by the stage and his Yihuang players; Pu wrote a casebook of feeling — feeling the constant, form the variable — in Liancheng, Xiang Yu, Jiaonuo, carried by text and remarks. The same work, legislating for feeling — one a theatrical system, the other a narrative casebook; the two agree that feeling defeats reason, differing in that Tang roots into inner experience and Pu opens onto the front of institutional critique.

cross_references.relation_note: 对比：市井即时戏剧 vs 案头终身批判
cross_references.description_zh: 蒲松龄与关汉卿同写底层、同刺贪虐，但载体与位置相反：关汉卿在市井瓦舍即时上演，'躬践排场'亲自下场，戏剧性外露、当场生效；蒲松龄在书斋灯下笔写四百余年，屡败科场的门外人，批判性内敛、借狐鬼而曲折——对照命题：对同一套压迫结构，'当场演给大众看'与'写成书给后世读'是两种都成立却策略相反的抵抗。
cross_references.description_en: Pu Songling and Guan Hanqing both write the lowly and stab greed and cruelty, but their carriers and stations are opposite: Guan plays the streets at once, treading the boards himself, the drama exposed, effective on the spot; Pu writes four hundred years by lamp in the studio, the man failed outside the halls, the critique folded inward and devious through foxes and ghosts — the contrast: against the same structure of oppression, 'playing now to the crowd' and 'writing a book for posterity' are two resistances both valid and opposite in strategy.

cross_references.description_zh: 蒲松龄与张载同为'为无形之物立法'者：张载为'气'立本体论（太虚即气），为价值立四句教；蒲松龄为'情'与'恩义'立可核算的规则（情是常量、恩义账本）——两人都把看不见的东西写成有结构、可执行的体系；差异在于张载的体系靠书院讲学传承，蒲松龄的体系靠故事与论赞传承——抽象规则的两种载体：讲义与故事。
cross_references.description_en: Pu Songling and Zhang Zai are both legislators for the intangible: Zhang Zai founded an ontology for qi — the great void itself qi — and the four sentences of value; Pu founded auditable rules for feeling and grace — feeling the constant, the ledger of favors — both writing the unseen into structured, executable systems; the difference: Zhang's system passed through academies and lecterns, Pu's through stories and remarks — two carriers of abstract rules: the lecture and the tale.

cross_references.description_zh: 蒲松龄与杜牧同为'以借喻批评权力'的锋利笔手，方向相反：杜牧借'已烧掉的宫殿'向当下皇帝递送亡国推理，批判锋芒藏在推演结构里，一次性、面向顶层；蒲松龄借'规则颠倒的镜城'（罗刹海市、司文郎、梦狼）向全社会乃至后世递送制度解剖，批判锋芒藏在故事里，可反复、面向所有人——对照命题：当批评无法直说时，可以选'历史的借喻'（杜牧），也可以选'虚构的镜城'（蒲松龄）。
cross_references.description_en: Pu Songling and Du Mu are both sharp hands at criticizing power through borrowed figures, in opposite directions: Du Mu hands the reigning emperor, through a palace already burned, a chain of reasoning toward ruin, the edge hidden in the structure of the argument, once, aimed at the top; Pu hands society and posterity, through a hall of mirrors with rules inverted — the Luocha Kingdom, the blind monk, the wolf-dream — an anatomy of institutions, repeatable, aimed at all — the contrast: when criticism cannot be spoken straight, choose the borrowed figure of history, Du Mu's way, or the mirror-city of fiction, Pu's.

modes.name_en: The Method of the Historian of the Strange
modes.category: 认知方法/以史家体例统摄志怪
modes.domain_zh: 蒲松龄给自己的书起的名字不是《聊斋》而是《聊斋志异》——'志'是史家的动作：记录、存档、按体例行文；他在每篇末尾仿《史记》'太史公曰'自设'异史氏曰'的论赞体，等于宣称：狐鬼花妖之事，与王侯将相之事，适用同一种史家处理程序。这个判断的深意在于：第一，体例即立场——用正史的'纪传体'写怪异，怪异就被当作正经史料对待，读者不知不觉进入'读史'的严肃姿态；第二，论赞是裁判席——'异史氏曰'在故事之外另开一层，把已经讲完的故事重新过一遍义理的秤，褒贬全在这一层；第三，名分即方法论——一个乡试屡败的穷塾师，借'史家'的名分获得对权贵、科场、官府的合法裁判权。他证明：给非主流材料套上最高规格的体例，是弱者为自己争取话语权的完整方法
modes.domain_en: Pu Songling named his book not the Liao Studio but the Records of the Strange from the Liao Studio — 'records' is the historian's act: to note, to archive, to write by a fixed form. At the end of each tale he set up an 'the Historian of the Strange says' in imitation of the Grand Historian's remarks, claiming thereby that matters of foxes, ghosts, flowers and demons are fit for the same procedure of history as matters of princes and generals. The depth of the judgment: first, the form is the stance — writing the strange in the annals-biography style of orthodox history treats the strange as serious archive, and the reader slips unawares into the grave posture of reading history; second, the closing remarks are the judge's bench — a layer apart from the story, where the tale told is weighed again on the scales of principle, praise and blame all in that layer; third, the name is the method — a poor tutor who failed the examinations year on year borrowed the historian's title to win lawful jurisdiction over the mighty, the examination halls and the yamen. He proved: to put non-mainstream material into the highest-grade form is a complete method by which the weak claims the right to speak
modes.source_chapter: 《聊斋志异》书名与'异史氏曰'论赞体；仿《史记》'太史公曰'
modes.key_quote_zh: 书名含'志'、篇末设'异史氏曰'——用正史体例写狐鬼，是对怪异材料最庄重的收编
modes.key_quote_en: "In the title a word of record, at each tale's end 'the Historian of the Strange says' — to write of foxes and ghosts in the form of orthodox history is the gravest act of adoption the strange can receive"
process_zh: 为你的材料选一种'规格最高'的现有体例：不发明新形式，而是借最庄严的旧形式（史书、法典、学术期刊）——体例自带权威
按体例的全部规程执行：体例的权威来自其规程，借体例就要完整执行其结构（纪传、编年、注释），不可半借半弃
在材料层之外另设'论赞层'：故事讲完后再开一层评断，把事实与义理分开——读者先被故事说服，再被论赞裁决
坚持名分直到它变成事实：一个人长期用史家体例处理边缘材料，体例的庄重会反过来改变材料的社会地位
process_en: Choose for your material an existing form of the highest grade: invent no new shape but borrow the most solemn old one — annals, codes, journals; the form carries its own authority
Execute the form's whole protocol: the authority comes from the protocol, and to borrow the form is to carry out its whole structure — annals, chronology, annotation — not half-borrow and half-drop

Beyond the material layer set up a remarks layer: after the story is told, open another layer of judgment, keeping fact and principle apart — the reader is won first by the story, then ruled by the remarks
Hold the title until it becomes fact: one who long handles marginal material in the historian's form will find the form's gravity changes the material's standing in the world
representative_cases_zh: 《促织》末尾'异史氏曰'：先讲完一只蟋蟀逼死全家的故事，再在论赞层点破'天子偶用一物'的荒谬——故事负责血泪，论赞负责问责
《聊斋自志》自述'才非干宝，雅爱搜神'：把自己的著述直接接到干宝《搜神记》的史志谱系上——为'志异'认祖归宗
《王子安》篇末连用'异史氏曰'拆解秀才入闱的'七似'：论赞层的刻毒远胜故事本身——故事是药，论赞是刀
representative_cases_en: The closing of the Cricket: the tale of a cricket that drives a family to ruin is told first, then the remarks layer lays bare the absurdity of 'the Son of Heaven using one thing at a passing whim' — the story carries the blood and tears, the remarks carry the reckoning

The author's own preface, 'my talent is not Gan Bao's, yet I love to gather the spirits': he joins his writing straight to the lineage of Gan Bao's In Search of the Spirits — giving his recording of the strange an ancestry in the records

At the end of Wang Zi'an the remarks dissect the 'seven likenesses' of a scholar entering the examination cell: the remarks layer cuts far deeper than the story — the story is the drug, the remarks the knife
modern_applications_zh: 用高规格体例包装边缘内容：把公司内刊写成正式年报体例、把个人研究写成期刊论文格式——体例的庄重会改变内容的被对待方式
事实与评断分两层交付：先讲完整故事/数据，再另开一节给判断——混在一起会两头打折
弱者借名分争裁判权：没有职位权威的人，可以通过采用权威话语的完整格式（听证会程序、审计报告体例）获得程序性话语权
modern_applications_en: Wrap marginal content in a high-grade form: write the house newsletter as a formal annual report, the private study as a journal paper — the gravity of the form changes how the content is treated
Deliver fact and judgment in two layers: tell the whole story or show the data first, then open a separate section for the verdict — mixed together, both are discounted

The weak claims jurisdiction by borrowed title: one without positional authority may win procedural voice by adopting the complete format of authoritative discourse — hearing procedures, audit-report forms

modes.category: 认知方法/以非人视角写透人性
modes.domain_zh: 蒲松龄写狐鬼花妖，不是把人变成鬼，而是把鬼变成人——《婴宁》里的狐女爱花爱笑，'笑处嫣然，狂而不损其媚'，到人间后被礼教一步步管教得'竟不复笑'；《小翠》里的狐女以嬉戏治愈痴儿、又替恩家化解政敌构陷，功成之后飘然离去。这个判断的深意在于：第一，非人身份是自由——狐鬼不受人间礼法管辖，蒲松龄让她们做出人间女性不被允许的一切（主动求爱、直言、大笑、出走），等于在虚构里立法；第二，人性在对比中显影——花妖的'真'照出人的'伪'：《画皮》的恶鬼披人皮，人却披着更难识破的'礼'皮；第三，异类的深情是试金石——狐鬼对人的情义常胜过人对人的情义，读者被迫重问'谁更像人'。他证明：要写透人性，最锋利的办法不是剖析人，而是造一面非人的镜子
modes.domain_en: Pu Songling wrote foxes, ghosts, flowers and demons not by turning people into ghosts but by turning ghosts into people — the fox girl of Yingning, who loves flowers and laughter, 'smiling bright, wild yet never losing grace', is tamed step by step by the proprieties of the world of men until 'she laughs no more'; the fox girl of Xiaocui cures a simple-minded son by her play and wards off political slander for her benefactor's house, and when the work is done she drifts away. The depth of the judgment: first, the non-human identity is freedom — foxes and ghosts stand outside human law, and Pu lets them do all that the women of his world were forbidden — to woo, to speak plainly, to laugh aloud, to leave — legislating inside fiction; second, human nature develops in contrast — the genuineness of the flower-demon exposes the falseness of men: the evil spirit of the Painted Skin wears human skin, while men wear the harder-to-see skin of propriety; third, the devotion of the other kind is the touchstone — fox and ghost often outdo men in faith, forcing the reader to ask again who is more human. He proved: to write human nature through, the sharpest way is not to dissect people but to build a mirror that is not human
modes.key_quote_zh: 写鬼写妖高人一等，刺贪刺虐入骨三分（郭沫若题联）——非人身份是自由，异类之真照出人之伪
modes.key_quote_en: "In writing ghosts and demons a grade above men; in stabbing greed and cruelty to the bone (Guo Moruo's couplet) — the non-human identity is freedom, and the truth of the other kind lights up the falseness of men"
process_zh: 为要讨论的人性问题选一个'不受该规则管辖'的载体：礼教压笑，就让不受礼教管辖的狐女来笑——载体越不受限，越能照出规则本身
给非人载体完整的内心逻辑：不是符号化的妖，而是有来历、有情义、有抉择的人物——读者先信其为'人'，对比才成立
安排非人与人的相遇作为实验场：同一情境下人如何做、非人如何做——差异处就是你的论点所在
让对比自己说话，不加裁决：把'谁更像人'留给读者——结论由读者自己得出时才有力量
process_en: For the human trait in question choose a carrier not governed by the rule: propriety suppresses laughter, so let a fox girl whom propriety cannot bind do the laughing — the freer the carrier, the plainer the rule itself shows
Give the non-human carrier a complete inner logic: not a symbol-demon but a figure with a past, affections and choices — readers must first believe in her as a person before the contrast can stand
Stage the meeting of non-human and human as the experiment: in the same situation what the person does and what the other does — the difference is your argument
Let the contrast speak and withhold the verdict: leave 'who is more human' to the reader — a conclusion reached by the reader is the only one with force
representative_cases_zh: 《婴宁》的笑与'竟不复笑'：全书写尽笑声之美，结尾一句'我不禁然'——礼教杀人不用刀的过程被写成一个笑的消失
《画皮》的双层画皮：鬼画人皮易识破，人披'道貌'难识破——王生爱上的'人'与恶鬼只隔一层纸
《小翠》的以戏为报：狐女用'游戏'完成救痴儿、退政敌两件大事，而恩家在她失手碎玉瓶时先责骂——人的凉薄由异类之厚照出
representative_cases_en: Yingning's laughter and 'she laughs no more': the whole tale sets out the beauty of her laughing, and the end in one line — the work of propriety killing without a knife is written as the vanishing of a laugh

The painted skin in two layers: the ghost's human skin is easy to see through, while men wear the harder skin of seeming virtue — between the 'person' Wang loves and the evil spirit lies only a sheet of paper

Xiaocui repaying with play: the fox girl achieves two great deeds through 'games' — curing the son and defeating the slanderer — yet when she shatters a jade vase her benefactors scold first; the coldness of men lit by the warmth of the other kind
modern_applications_zh: 用'局外人'角色做组织诊断：让新员工、外包人员、AI助手来评说组织内部习以为常的做法——不受规则管辖者最能照出规则的荒谬
产品设计的'非人用户'测试：问'一个完全不懂行业惯例的人第一次用会怎样'——惯例掩盖的缺陷只有在视角外才可见
写作与品牌的异类镜像：用动物、AI、外星人的第一人称写人类行为（如《我是猫》）——距离产生洞察
modern_applications_en: Use an outsider role for organizational diagnosis: let the new hire, the contractor, the AI assistant comment on practices taken for granted inside — the unbound agent best exposes the absurdity of the rule
The non-human user test in design: ask how someone wholly ignorant of the field's conventions would fare on first use — defects hidden by habit are visible only from outside it
The alien mirror in writing and brand: write human behavior in the first person of an animal, an AI, an alien — distance yields insight
representative_figures: 蒲松龄
夏目漱石（《我是猫》以猫眼观人间）
卡夫卡（《变形记》以虫身写人的处境）
纪昀（《阅微草堂笔记》的狐鬼多作理学说教，人格化远逊）
安徒生（以小美人鱼写牺牲与灵魂）
modes.definition_zh: 蒲松龄写狐鬼花妖，不是把人变成鬼，而是把鬼变成人——《婴宁》里的狐女爱花爱笑，'笑处嫣然，狂而不损其媚'，到人间后被礼教一步步管教得'竟不复笑'；《小翠》里的狐女以嬉戏治愈痴儿、又替恩家化解政敌构陷，功成之后飘然离去。这个判断的深意在于：第一，非人身份是自由——狐鬼不受人间礼法管辖，蒲松龄让她们做出人间女性不被允许的一切（主动求爱、直言、大笑、出走），等于在虚构里立法；第二，人性在对比中显影——花妖的'真'照出人的'伪'：《画皮》的恶鬼披人皮，人却披着更难识破的'礼'皮；第三，异类的深情是试金石——狐鬼对人的情义常胜过人对人的情义，读者被迫重问'谁更像人'。他证明：要写透人性，最锋利的办法不是剖析人，而是造一面非人的镜子
modes.definition_en: Pu Songling wrote foxes, ghosts, flowers and demons not by turning people into ghosts but by turning ghosts into people — the fox girl of Yingning, who loves flowers and laughter, 'smiling bright, wild yet never losing grace', is tamed step by step by the proprieties of the world of men until 'she laughs no more'; the fox girl of Xiaocui cures a simple-minded son by her play and wards off political slander for her benefactor's house, and when the work is done she drifts away. The depth of the judgment: first, the non-human identity is freedom — foxes and ghosts stand outside human law, and Pu lets them do all that the women of his world were forbidden — to woo, to speak plainly, to laugh aloud, to leave — legislating inside fiction; second, human nature develops in contrast — the genuineness of the flower-demon exposes the falseness of men: the evil spirit of the Painted Skin wears human skin, while men wear the harder-to-see skin of propriety; third, the devotion of the other kind is the touchstone — fox and ghost often outdo men in faith, forcing the reader to ask again who is more human. He proved: to write human nature through, the sharpest way is not to dissect people but to build a mirror that is not human

modes.name_en: The Method of the Great Case in Small Hands
modes.category: 方法论/以小人物小切口揭大制度
modes.domain_zh: 蒲松龄几乎不写皇帝与宰相，他写成名这样的穷书生、席方平这样的乡下人、王六郎这样的水鬼——但每一篇小人物的故事背后都是完整的制度解剖：《促织》写'宫中尚促织之戏'一句话引出层层摊派直到家破人亡，一只蟋蟀的征敛链条上从天子到里胥一环不少；《席方平》写一个乡下人到阴间告状，历经城隍、郡司、冥王全部受贿，整座官僚机器的地府镜像被一状写尽。这个判断的深意在于：第一，制度的重量在末端最清楚——天子一举动，底下就是无数个成名的家破人亡，从末端写起比从朝廷写起更能让读者摸到制度的实体；第二，小人物无路可走时，制度全貌才显形——席方平一层层上告、一层层碰壁，诉讼路径本身就是官府结构图；第三，具体的一例胜过抽象的万例——'每责一头，辄倾数家之产'比任何'横征暴敛'的论述都重。他证明：解剖大制度，最锋利的刀是讲透一个小人物的完整遭遇
modes.domain_en: Pu Songling almost never writes emperors and chancellors; he writes poor scholars like Cheng Ming, villagers like Xi Fangping, a water ghost like Wang Liulang — yet behind every tale of a small figure lies a whole institutional anatomy: the Cricket opens on one line, 'the palace favors the sport of crickets', and from that one fancy the levies cascade until families are ruined; on the chain of exaction for one cricket not a link is missing from the Son of Heaven to the village bailiff; in Xi Fangping a villager sues in the underworld and finds the City God, the Prefect and the King of Hell all bribed — the whole bureaucratic machine mirrored as hell laid bare in one suit. The depth of the judgment: first, the weight of a system is clearest at its far end — one gesture of the throne means countless ruined households like Cheng Ming's, and to begin at the end lets the reader touch the system's substance better than any court scene; second, when the small figure has nowhere to turn, the system's whole shape appears — Xi Fangping appealing level by level and striking walls level by level, the path of the suit itself a map of officialdom; third, one concrete case outweighs ten thousand abstractions — 'each levy of one cricket bankrupts several families' weighs more than any essay on rapacious taxation. He proved: to dissect a great system, the sharpest knife is one small figure's complete story told through
modes.key_quote_zh: 天子偶用一物，未必不过此已忘；而奉行者即为定例（《促织》）——从一只蟋蟀写尽整个征敛制度
modes.key_quote_en: "The Son of Heaven used one thing at a whim and may have forgotten it at once; yet those who carried it out made it standing law (the Cricket) — from a single cricket, the whole system of exaction"
process_zh: 选制度链条最末端的承受者做主角：不写决策层，写被决策碾过的那个人——末端的故事自带全部上游的重量
给小人物一次'穷尽所有正规途径'的经历：一层层求助、一层层失望——路径的形状就是制度的形状
标出每一次加码的具体经手人：从源头到末端每一环都点名（宫中—抚军—县令—里胥）——责任链不抽象
用一句可引用的定量判断收束：'每责一头，辄倾数家之产'——把结构性暴力度量成一个可传诵的句子
process_en: Choose as protagonist the bearer at the chain's far end: write not the decision-makers but the one crushed by them — the end-of-chain story carries the weight of all upstream
Give the small figure one experience of exhausting every lawful path: appeal level by level, fail level by level — the shape of the path is the shape of the system
Name the handler at each escalation: from source to end, every link called by its office — palace, governor, magistrate, bailiff — the chain of responsibility kept concrete
Close on one quotable quantitative judgment: 'each levy of one cricket bankrupts several families' — structural violence measured into a sentence that travels
representative_cases_zh: 《促织》的责任链全息：宫中一戏→抚军进献→县令勒派→里胥猾黠，成名一家只是链条最末的承压点——一百五十字写完四层加码
《席方平》的阴间三层碰壁：城隍拘押、郡司不理、冥王笞械——'金光盖地，因使阎摩殿上尽是阴霾'把整套官僚机器判为贪腐同构
《梦狼》的'窃叹天下之官虎而吏狼者，比比也'：把官场写成一个白骨堆上的虎狼宴——制度性食人由一场梦呈现
representative_cases_en: The Cricket's hologram of responsibility: one palace sport, tribute from the governor, exaction by the magistrate, cunning of the bailiff — Cheng Ming's family merely the pressure point at the chain's end, four escalations written in a hundred and fifty characters

Xi Fangping striking walls on three levels of hell: detained by the City God, ignored by the Prefect, flogged by the King of Hell — 'a golden light covers the earth, and the halls of Yama are all murk' condemns the whole machine as one corruption
The Wolf-Bureaucrats of the dream: officialdom written as a feast of tigers and wolves over a mound of bones — institutional cannibalism presented in a dream
modern_applications_zh: 调研先找'末端承受者'：了解一项政策/系统，直接访谈被它压在最底层的用户或员工——末端故事自带全链条信息量
投诉路径本身就是审计工具：让一件事走完全部正规流程并逐层记录响应——流程形状即组织真实结构
用具体个案代替统计做传播：'这一家因一只蟋蟀破产'比'横征暴敛率上升'更可传播——定量化的单例是最锋利的叙事武器
modern_applications_en: In research, start at the end-bearer: to understand a policy or system, interview first the user or employee crushed at its bottom — the end-of-chain story carries the whole chain
The complaint path is itself an audit tool: run one matter through every lawful channel and log each response — the shape of the process is the organization's true structure
Replace statistics with one concrete case for spread: 'this family was ruined by a cricket' travels where 'exaction rates rose' does not — the quantified single case is the sharpest narrative weapon

modes.name_en: The Method of Love Beyond Form
modes.category: 认知方法/以情之生死重估身份界限
modes.domain_zh: 《连城》里乔生割下胸前之肉为连城作药引，连城死而复生后自请'必以尸配'；《香玉》里牡丹花妖香玉被掘去，白牡丹枯死，痴情的黄生哭花作诗日日临穴涕洟，竟感动花神使香玉复生；ρθ叔平…《宦娘》里人鬼以琴声相知而不求形偶。这个判断的深意在于：第一，情是身份的宪法——在蒲松龄的世界里，人鬼婚、人狐恋、人花恋之所以成立，不靠门第形貌，只靠'知己'二字：连城说'士为知己者死'，乔生真的以死相报；第二，形是情的变量，不是常量——容貌会变（画皮）、身体会死（连城）、物种会隔（香玉），情却贯穿形变而存续——他把爱情的常量从'形'改写为'知'；第三，情死而复生是对现实婚制的反向立法——现实里婚姻讲门第，他在虚构里让'情'拥有推翻生死的效力，等于写了一部情高于形的判例集。他证明：任何被默认为'常量'的资格条件（出身、外貌、身份），都可以被一种更深的力量重估为变量
modes.domain_en: In Liancheng, Qiao Sheng cuts flesh from his own breast for the medicine that revives Liancheng, and she, living again, asks to be wedded in death; in Xiang Yu, when the peony-spirit Xiangyu is dug away and withers, the devoted Huang weeps at her grave daily with poems, till the flower goddess, moved, restores her; in Huanniang, a ghost and a man know each other through the qin and ask no bodily union. The depth of the judgment: first, feeling is the constitution of identity — in Pu's world the marriage of man and ghost, of man and fox, of man and flower, rests not on rank or looks but on the two words 'one who knows me': Liancheng speaks the scholar dies for him who knows him, and Qiao repays with death in earnest; second, form is a variable of love, not its constant — faces change (the Painted Skin), bodies die (Liancheng), species divide (Xiang Yu), while feeling persists through the change of form — he rewrote the constant of love from form to knowing; third, love's victory over death is reverse legislation against the marriage regime — where the world's marriages weigh pedigree, in his fiction feeling holds power to overturn life and death, a casebook of judgments in which love outranks form. He proved: any qualification taken as a constant — birth, looks, status — can be reweighed as a variable by a deeper force
modes.key_quote_zh: 士为知己者死，不以色也（《连城》）——情是常量，形是变量
modes.key_quote_en: "A scholar dies for him who knows him — not for beauty (Liancheng) — feeling the constant, form the variable"
process_zh: 找出领域里被默认的'资格常量'：出身、学历、容貌、资历——凡被当作前置条件的，都标记为待重估项
设计一次'常量失效、关系存续'的检验：让形貌、身份、生死在关系中变动，看什么留了下来——留下来的才是真的常量
以'知己'为关系的充分条件重新立法：谁能看见你的本质，谁就有资格进入最深的契约——用判例（具体故事）而非条文立此法
让重估的代价真实付清：乔生割肉、黄生日日哭穴——重估若无代价背书，只是宣言
process_en: Find the qualification-constants your field takes for granted: birth, credentials, looks, seniority — mark every precondition as pending reweighing
Design one test in which the constant fails and the relation survives: let looks, status, life itself change within the relation and see what remains — what remains is the true constant
Re-legislate on 'one who knows me' as sufficient condition: whoever sees your essence qualifies for the deepest contract — establish it by cases, concrete stories, not by statute
Pay the cost of reweighing in full: Qiao cutting his flesh, Huang weeping daily at the grave — revaluation without paid cost is mere declaration
representative_cases_zh: 《连城》的三次以死相许：割肉、殉死、还魂——每一层'形'的边界（肉身、生死、家法）都被'知己'之情逐一击穿
《香玉》的以情续命：黄生哭花十日，花神感其至情使香玉复生——'情之至'被写成可以提交给宇宙裁决的诉由
《娇娜》的'腻友'：孔生与狐女娇娜一生以医术与道义相托，'色授魂与'而不逾——情不必以婚形落实，高于婚形
representative_cases_en: Liancheng's three pledges unto death: flesh cut, death shared, return from the grave — each boundary of form, body, death and family law, broken through one by one by the bond of knowing

Xiang Yu's life renewed by feeling: ten days of weeping at the flower's grave, and the goddess of flowers, moved by such feeling, restores her — 'feeling at its utmost' pleaded as a cause the universe itself adjudicates

The 'friend of the flesh's longing' in Jiaonuo: Kong Sheng and the fox girl Jiaonuo trust each other for life in medicine and honor, 'eyes granting, soul meeting', never overstepping — feeling without the form of marriage, above that form
modern_applications_zh: 重估组织里的'资格常量'：招聘、晋升把学历/年限当硬条件时，先问'哪些被证明的业绩可以穿透这些前置条件'——建立类似乔生'割肉'式的例外通道
把'被看见'做成产品核心价值：用户留存的最深动力常是'有系统真正懂我'（知己效应）——推荐系统、教练产品都在卖'知'
为关系建立'变量清单'：区分关系中真正的常量（信任、理解）与变量（外表、职位、财富）——变量波动时不误判为关系破裂
modern_applications_en: Reweigh your organization's qualification-constants: when hiring and promotion treat degrees and years as hard gates, ask which proven deeds may pierce the gates — build exception channels of Qiao-cutting-his-flesh grade
Make 'being known' the core value of a product: the deepest retention force is a system that truly knows me — recommendation engines and coaching products sell knowing

Keep a variable list for any relationship: distinguish the true constants (trust, understanding) from variables (looks, position, wealth) — when variables move, do not misread it as the relation breaking

modes.name_en: The Method of Laughter and Tears as Twin Testimony
modes.category: 方法论/以喜剧外壳装载悲剧内核
modes.domain_zh: 《王子安》写秀才放榜前的癫狂：醉中被狐戏弄，幻觉里报录人敲门、长班伺候、 出鬼喝道，一场大梦做尽'入围七似'的丑态——读者笑他，笑完发现七似写的全是自己；崂山道士写王七羡慕仙术、剪纸为月、与仙人共饮，最后碰壁额上包——读者笑他妄想，笑完想起自己也曾想'不劳而获'。这个判断的深意在于：第一，笑是防御的门户——读者对悲剧有心理防御，对喜剧没有，蒲松龄把刀从笑口递进去，防御机制形同虚设；第二，可笑即可怜——'七似'（初入时丐者之似、唱名时囚之似……）每一似都是笑点，每一似都是辛酸，笑点与泪点在同一处重合；第三，喜剧是对命运的赦免式呈现——把科场的荒谬写成闹剧，比写成控诉更容易通过审查、也更容易流传。他证明：想让真话走得最远，就把它写成笑话
modes.domain_en: Wang Zi'an tells of a scholar gone mad before the posting of results: drunk and toyed with by a fox, he dreams the runners knocking, the lackeys in waiting, the honor guard of a ghost, and plays out all the 'seven likenesses' of the candidate in his cell — readers laugh at him, and finding the seven likenesses written all about themselves; the Taoist of Laoshan sends Wang Qi, covetous of magic, to fold the moon from paper and drink with immortals, till he bumps his head on the wall — readers laugh at his dream of something for nothing, then remember their own. The depth of the judgment: first, laughter is the gate of defense — readers have defenses against tragedy and none against comedy; Pu passes the knife in through the laughing mouth, the guard rendered useless; second, the laughable is the pitiable — each of the seven likenesses, beggar at entering, prisoner at the naming, is a joke and an anguish at once, the funny bone and the sore bone lying in the same spot; third, comedy is an absolving presentation of fate — the absurdity of the examination halls written as farce passes the censors and travels farther than any indictment. He proved: to make truth travel farthest, write it as a joke
modes.source_chapter: 《王子安》《崂山道士》《司文郎》《嘉平公子》
modes.key_quote_zh: 秀才入闱七似：丐、囚、蜂、病、絷、槐、蟹——每一似都是笑点，每一似都是辛酸
modes.key_quote_en: "The seven likenesses of the candidate in his cell — beggar, prisoner, bee, sick man, tethered beast, gazing one, crab — every likeness a joke, every likeness an anguish"
process_zh: 给要说的真话找一层'可笑的外壳'：把控诉写成闹剧、把悲剧写成荒诞——先让读者笑，绕过对说教的防御
让笑点与痛点在同一处重合：设计'读者笑主角时看见自己'的瞬间——自嘲式共鸣是最深的共鸣
用荒诞的'假规则'做真实制度的放大镜：剪纸为月是假的，'不劳而获必碰壁'是真的——假事越荒诞，真理越醒目
收束在一句让笑声停住的判词：笑到最响时给一句冷静的义理——'异史氏曰'的刀在此落下
process_en: Find a laughable shell for the truth you must tell: write the indictment as farce, the tragedy as absurdity — let readers laugh first, bypassing their defense against preaching
Make the funny bone and the sore bone lie in the same spot: design the moment when readers laughing at the hero see themselves — self-mocking recognition is the deepest
Use an absurd false rule as a magnifier of the real one: a moon folded of paper is false, that something-for-nothing ends in a bump is true — the more absurd the fiction, the plainer the truth
Close with a verdict that stops the laughter: at the loudest laugh give one cold line of principle — the knife of 'the Historian of the Strange says' falls there
representative_cases_zh: 《王子安》七似的自我指认：读者在'唱名时似囚'里看见自己赶工交差的状态——笑话的结构与读者的处境同构
《崂山道士》的'其额上果否有包'收尾：妻子嘲笑后一句反问把镜子转向读者——你嘲笑王七，你的额上有包吗
《司文郎》的盲僧以鼻嗅文：瞎眼和尚能'闻'出文章好坏而考官不能——把科场黑暗写成嗅觉喜剧，讽刺比控诉更入骨
representative_cases_en: The seven likenesses as self-recognition: readers see their own deadline sprint in 'like a prisoner at the naming' — the structure of the joke and the reader's condition isomorphic
The closing question of the Taoist of Laoshan: after the wife's mockery, one line turns the mirror on the reader — you laughed at Wang Qi; is there a bump on your forehead?

The blind monk who smells essays in Si Wen Lang: a sightless monk judges prose by the nose better than the examiners by their eyes — the darkness of the halls written as an olfactory comedy, its satire deeper than any indictment
modern_applications_zh: 用喜剧短片/段子做严肃议题传播：'笑点即入口'——讽刺喜剧能让制度批评抵达控诉文到不了的人群
在吐槽文化里藏诊断：组织内把'可笑的流程'编成段子传播——笑声扩散处就是变革共识形成处
设计'自嘲式共鸣'内容：让用户在笑产品/行业陋习时认出自己——自嘲完成教育，说教招致防御
modern_applications_en: Use comedy sketches for serious subjects: the laugh is the entry — satire reaches people that indictments never do
Hide diagnosis inside the roast: in-house, turn absurd procedures into jokes that spread — where the laughter spreads, consensus for change forms
Design self-mocking recognition: let users laugh at a product's or industry's habits and see themselves — mockery teaches, preaching defends

modes.name_en: The Method of the Wondrous Encounter
modes.category: 方法论/以叙事装置重排命运概率
modes.domain_zh: 《王六郎》里许姓渔人每夜河边饮酒，必洒酒奠水中溺鬼——一份无心的善意换来鬼友替他驱鱼；《罗刹海市》里商人之子马骥漂流到以丑为美、以美为丑的罗刹国，又入海市龙宫，凭一篇《海市赋》娶龙女、成驸马；《翩翩》里落魄浪子罗子浮被仙女翩翩救入山洞，溪水洗疮、芭蕉为衣、山叶成饼。这个判断的深意在于：第一，奇遇是命运的'重开接口'——现实里阶层、际遇近乎封死，蒲松龄在叙事里设置了另一个入口（水中、海外、山洞），让善意、才华、真诚这些现实里贬值的东西重新定价；第二，奇遇的资格是品行而非机运——许渔人得鬼友因常年奠酒，马骥得龙女因文才，罗子浮得仙女却须先经溪水洗尽疮污——奇遇看似运气，实际是一套'善行兑换表'；第三，仙缘终要收束——王六郎最终升神而去，罗子浮老死洞中思归则归——奇遇是暂借的，归还时人已不同。他证明：叙事可以为一个在现实中无处兑换美德的人，重新发行一套货币
modes.domain_en: In Wang Liuliang a fisherman surnamed Xu pours wine each night into the river for the drowned ghost — an uncalculating kindness returned by a ghost friend who schools the fish into his net; in the Luocha Kingdom a merchant's son drifts to a land where ugly is fair and fair ugly, then into the dragon palace of the sea-market, where one rhapsody wins him the dragon daughter; Piaopiao rescues the ruined rover Luo Zifu into a mountain cave — the stream washes his sores, banana leaves serve as clothes, mountain leaves become bread. The depth of the judgment: first, the wondrous encounter is a reopened interface of fate — in the real world station and chance are nearly sealed; Pu sets up another entrance in story — underwater, over the sea, in the cave — where kindness, talent and sincerity, debased in reality, are repriced; second, the qualification for wonder is character, not luck — the fisherman earns the ghost by years of libation, Ma Ji the dragon daughter by his talent, Luo Zifu the immortal only after the stream washes his sores clean — the encounter looks like chance but is a schedule of virtue-exchange; third, the wondrous bond must close — Wang Liuliang at last ascends as a god, Luo Zifu grows old in the cave or returns home — the encounter is borrowed, and at the return the man is changed. He proved: narrative can re-issue a currency for a man whose virtue has nowhere to be redeemed in reality
modes.source_chapter: 《王六郎》《罗刹海市》《翩翩》《西湖主》《晚霞》
modes.key_quote_zh: 仆亦何心，遂蒙宠惠？然有好生之德（《王六郎》）——奇遇看似运气，实为善行的兑换表
modes.key_quote_en: "What design had I, to receive such favor? Yet there is the virtue of loving life (Wang Liuliang) — the encounter looks like luck, but is a schedule of virtue-exchange"
process_zh: 承认现实世界的'汇率失效'：先如实写出美德在现实中的贬值（善意无报、才华无处售）——这是奇遇叙事的起点而非终点
设计一个'另一套规则成立'的入口：水中、海外、梦境、山洞——入口即新制度的边界，跨过去规则全变
把品行写成新规则的硬通货：在新世界里善良/才华/真诚必须真的能兑换——否则奇遇只是另一种现实
给奇遇设归还条款：机会终会收回（升神、思归、梦醒）——读者带走的是'人已不同'，而非幻想永驻
process_en: Admit the real world's failed exchange rate: write honestly how virtue is debased in reality — kindness unrewarded, talent unsold — the starting point of wonder, not its end
Design an entrance where another rule holds: underwater, over the sea, in dream, in the cave — the entrance is the border of a new regime; cross it and every rule changes
Make character the hard currency of the new rule: inside the new world kindness, talent, sincerity must truly redeem — otherwise the wonder is just reality again
Attach a clause of return: the chance will be recalled — ascension, homesickness, waking; what the reader carries away is 'the man is changed', not a fantasy to dwell in forever
representative_cases_zh: 《王六郎》的'善行兑换表'：奠酒（善意）→驱鱼（回报）→六郎升神让位（机会的转移）→'仁人之心'的最终评级——全篇是一次完整的善行结算
《罗刹海市》的双重奇遇：罗刹国'以丑为美'是现实的黑色镜像，海市龙宫'以才为贵'是理想司法——两个世界互为对照，讽刺与理想各有归宿
《翩翩》的'芭蕉为衣、山叶成饼'：仙女以物性魔法治疗浪子的疮与心——奇遇附带一场人格修复，疮愈即心愈
representative_cases_en: Wang Liuliang's schedule of virtue-exchange: libation (kindness), fish driven into the net (return), the ghost's ascension yielding his post (the chance transferred), the final rating 'the heart of the benevolent' — a whole tale one complete settlement of kindness

The double encounter of the Luocha tale: the kingdom where ugly is fair, a black mirror of reality; the dragon palace where talent is honored, an ideal court — the two worlds set against each other, satire and ideal each given its home

Banana leaves for clothes, mountain leaves for bread in Piaopiao: the immortal heals the rover's sores and his heart with the magic of things — the encounter comes with a repair of character, sores healed, heart healed
modern_applications_zh: 为'美德无处兑换'的人群设计再定价机制：公益产品、创作者激励的核心是给现实中贬值的善行/才华发行可兑换的'新货币'（声誉、流通、收入）
把'奇遇叙事'用在品牌故事里：用户不是被广告说服的，是被'另一个入口'的可能性说服的——入口设计（新场景、新社区）比说服更有效
给机会设归还条款：一切'突然的好运'都应预设退出与归还机制（试用期、可撤销授权）——借贷式幸运观让组织与个人都更稳
modern_applications_en: Design re-pricing mechanisms for those whose virtue has nowhere to redeem: the core of public-benefit products and creator incentives is issuing a redeemable new currency — reputation, circulation, income — for kindness and talent debased in reality
Use the wondrous-encounter arc in brand story: users are not persuaded by ads but by the possibility of another entrance — designing the entrance (new scene, new community) beats persuasion
Attach a clause of return to every stroke of luck: any sudden good fortune should carry preset exit and repayment — a loan-shaped view of luck steadies both organizations and persons

modes.name_en: The Method of the Ledger of Grace and Debt
modes.category: 方法论/以因果账本统摄伦理叙事
modes.domain_zh: 《聊斋》大量篇章的结构是一笔'恩义账'：《田七郎》里武承休赠金求交，田母断然拒绝——'受人之恩而死之'的账一旦记下，穷户要以命偿还；《西湖主》里猪婆龙因陈弼教一救，后其溺水入龙宫获报；《王六郎》的奠酒之情以驱鱼偿还，升神之位又以'仁人'让渡。这个判断的深意在于：第一，恩义是可记账、可结算的硬约束——蒲松龄笔下恩有数额（一饭、一救、一赠）、有利息（还命、还业、还位）、有币种（金、命、位、情），账本逻辑严过法律；第二，账本的两面都被写出——受恩者以命偿恩（田七郎'受人之恩而死之'），施恩者也可能以恩挟人（武承休赠金本质是购买一个肯为他死的人）——蒲松龄不美化账本，只精确记账；第三，账本会跨代结转——父债子还、祖恩孙报，《聊斋》的因果账常常跨越两三代结算。他证明：把伦理写成可核算的账本，是让'义'免于空谈的最硬办法
modes.domain_en: Many tales of the Liao Studio have the structure of a ledger of grace and debt: in Tian Qilang, Wu Chengxiu offers gold to buy a friendship, and Tian's mother refuses flatly — once the account of receiving grace is opened, a poor house repays it with life; in the Lord of the West Lake the bond of one rescue made to the mother dragon is repaid when Chen Bijiao, drowned, is received into the dragon palace; the libation of Wang Liuliang is repaid with fish, and the god's vacancy with the post itself. The depth of the judgment: first, grace and debt are hard constraints, bookable and settleable — in Pu's world grace has an amount (a meal, a rescue, a gift), an interest (a life, a deed, a post) and a currency (gold, life, rank, feeling), and the ledger binds harder than law; second, both sides of the ledger are written — the debtor repays with life (Tian Qilang, 'having received grace, dies for it'), while the creditor may use grace to own a man (Wu's gold is in essence the purchase of one willing to die for him) — Pu does not beautify the ledger, only keeps it exactly; third, the ledger carries across generations — the father's debt on the son, the ancestor's grace on the grandson, settlement often two or three generations later. He proved: to write ethics as an auditable ledger is the hardest way to keep 'righteousness' out of empty talk
modes.source_chapter: 《田七郎》《西湖主》《王六郎》《崔猛》《大力将军》
modes.key_quote_zh: 受人之恩而死之，强梁世界，原无半分人气（《田七郎》）——恩义账本逻辑严过法律
modes.key_quote_en: "Having received grace, one dies for it; in a world of the strong, human warmth is otherwise absent (Tian Qilang) — the ledger of grace binds harder than law"
process_zh: 把伦理关系改写成账目：每一份恩情记下数额、币种、时效——'谁欠谁、欠多少、以什么偿还'写清楚，义气就有了核算标准
写出账本的双面性：受恩者的重负与施恩者的购买力同时呈现——不回避'恩'可能是一种支配
让结算真实发生：账必须以可感的代价结清（命、业、位），不允许'心理偿还'——结算的硬度决定伦理的硬度
允许跨代与跨形态结转：恩可以以位还、以业还、隔代还——账本的弹性让它在长时段里仍然闭合
process_en: Rewrite ethical relations as accounts: record each grace's amount, currency and term — who owes whom, how much, repayable in what — and righteousness gains an auditing standard
Write both sides of the ledger: the debtor's burden and the creditor's buying power shown together — not dodging that 'grace' can be a form of domination
Let settlement really happen: the account must be closed at a felt cost — a life, a deed, a post; no 'psychological repayment' — the hardness of settlement decides the hardness of ethics
Allow carry-over across generations and forms: grace repaid with a post, a deed, a grandson's service — the ledger's elasticity keeps it closed over long spans
representative_cases_zh: 《田七郎》的拒账与认账：田母先拒'受恩'（知是买命钱），后家败受金——一旦记账，田七郎便以'死之'结清，账本逻辑推到极限
《西湖主》的一救之报：陈弼教救猪婆龙一次，溺水后全家入龙宫封侯——恩的利息按恩的规格复利
《王六郎》的三段结算：酒情以鱼偿、鱼情以神位让、让位以'仁人'之名定案——同一账本上恩的币种逐级升格
representative_cases_en: Tian Qilang refusing and then honoring the account: the mother first refuses the gold, knowing it buys a death; the house ruined, the gold is taken — and once the account opens, Tian closes it by dying, the ledger's logic driven to its limit
One rescue repaid in the Lord of the West Lake: one act of saving the dragon mother returns a drowned man a marquisate in the palace — grace's interest compounds at grace's own grade

Wang Liuliang's three-part settlement: wine repaid with fish, fish repaid with a god's vacancy yielded, the yield sealed by the name 'the benevolent' — on one ledger, grace's currency upgraded step by step
modern_applications_zh: 把'人情管理'显性化：团队里谁帮了谁、帮到什么程度，值得建立可见的互助记录——隐性的恩义账最容易变成怨气账
警惕'恩'的支配面：给予者要自问是否在用恩情购买服从——健康组织把恩义转为制度化回报（晋升、股权）而非私人债
跨周期结转的道义承诺：长期合作、代际事业里，'上一代的人情'要不要认、怎么认——先立结转规则再行事
modern_applications_en: Make favor-management visible: who helped whom, to what degree, deserves a legible record of mutual aid — the implicit ledger of favors curdles most easily into a ledger of grudges

Beware the dominating face of grace: givers should ask whether they are buying obedience with kindness — healthy organizations convert grace into institutional return (promotion, equity) rather than private debt

Carry moral commitments across cycles: in long partnerships and generational undertakings, decide in advance whether the previous generation's favors are honored and how — set the carry-over rule before acting
representative_figures: 蒲松龄
司马迁（'一饭之恩必偿'的信陵君与侯嬴谱系）
《水浒传》作者施耐庵（江湖恩义的账本与反噬）
狄更斯（《远大前程'恩主之谜的账本结构）
费孝通（'差序格局'对恩义账本的社会学重述）
modes.definition_zh: 《聊斋》大量篇章的结构是一笔'恩义账'：《田七郎》里武承休赠金求交，田母断然拒绝——'受人之恩而死之'的账一旦记下，穷户要以命偿还；《西湖主》里猪婆龙因陈弼教一救，后其溺水入龙宫获报；《王六郎》的奠酒之情以驱鱼偿还，升神之位又以'仁人'让渡。这个判断的深意在于：第一，恩义是可记账、可结算的硬约束——蒲松龄笔下恩有数额（一饭、一救、一赠）、有利息（还命、还业、还位）、有币种（金、命、位、情），账本逻辑严过法律；第二，账本的两面都被写出——受恩者以命偿恩（田七郎'受人之恩而死之'），施恩者也可能以恩挟人（武承休赠金本质是购买一个肯为他死的人）——蒲松龄不美化账本，只精确记账；第三，账本会跨代结转——父债子还、祖恩孙报，《聊斋》的因果账常常跨越两三代结算。他证明：把伦理写成可核算的账本，是让'义'免于空谈的最硬办法
modes.definition_en: Many tales of the Liao Studio have the structure of a ledger of grace and debt: in Tian Qilang, Wu Chengxiu offers gold to buy a friendship, and Tian's mother refuses flatly — once the account of receiving grace is opened, a poor house repays it with life; in the Lord of the West Lake the bond of one rescue made to the mother dragon is repaid when Chen Bijiao, drowned, is received into the dragon palace; the libation of Wang Liuliang is repaid with fish, and the god's vacancy with the post itself. The depth of the judgment: first, grace and debt are hard constraints, bookable and settleable — in Pu's world grace has an amount (a meal, a rescue, a gift), an interest (a life, a deed, a post) and a currency (gold, life, rank, feeling), and the ledger binds harder than law; second, both sides of the ledger are written — the debtor repays with life (Tian Qilang, 'having received grace, dies for it'), while the creditor may use grace to own a man (Wu's gold is in essence the purchase of one willing to die for him) — Pu does not beautify the ledger, only keeps it exactly; third, the ledger carries across generations — the father's debt on the son, the ancestor's grace on the grandson, settlement often two or three generations later. He proved: to write ethics as an auditable ledger is the hardest way to keep 'righteousness' out of empty talk

modes.name_en: The Method of the Inverted Mirror
modes.category: 方法论/以规则颠倒的世界照见现实
modes.domain_zh: 《罗刹海市》的罗刹国'所重，不在文章，而在形貌'——而他们以丑为美：貌俊如马骥者被视为怪物，涂黑脸扮张飞反而得官；《司文郎》里盲僧能以鼻嗅出文章好坏，主考官却眼明而目盲——衡文者不识文；《梦狼》里官衙就是虎狼之穴，堂上坐虎、阶下狼，白骨如山。这个判断的深意在于：第一，颠倒是最安全的映射——直接写'朝廷以丑为美'是谤书，写一个'以丑为美'的海外岛国是志怪——规则颠倒一层，指涉就安全一层，锋利却不减；第二，镜子要照'规则'而非'事件'——罗刹国颠倒的是审美标准，司文郎颠倒的是评审资格，梦狼颠倒的是官职性质——每篇颠倒一条规则，拼起来是整套价值的镜城；第三，颠倒带来可笑、可笑掩护判决——读者先觉得荒诞好笑，随后认出'这不就是我们这儿'——判决在笑声里送达。他证明：想安全而锋利地批评现实，就为现实造一面规则颠倒的镜子
modes.domain_en: In the Luocha Kingdom, what is prized is not letters but looks — and their standard inverts beauty: one handsome as Ma Ji is taken for a monster, and painted black as Zhang Fei he gains office; in Si Wen Lang a blind monk smells out the worth of essays, while the examiner, sighted, is blind — the judge of letters knows no letters; in the Wolf-Dream the yamen is a den of tigers and wolves, a tiger on the seat, wolves below the steps, white bones heaped like hills. The depth of the judgment: first, inversion is the safest mapping — to write 'the court prizes ugliness' outright is a libel; to write an island kingdom overseas that prizes ugliness is a tale of the strange — invert one layer of rule and the reference gains one layer of safety without losing its edge; second, the mirror must reflect rules, not events — the Luocha tale inverts the standard of beauty, the blind monk the qualification of judges, the wolf-dream the nature of office — one rule inverted per tale, and joined they build a hall of mirrors of a whole value system; third, inversion breeds laughter, and laughter shields the verdict — readers first find the absurdity funny, then recognize 'this is us' — the verdict delivered inside the laugh. He proved: to criticize reality safely and sharply, build reality a mirror with its rules reversed
modes.source_chapter: 《罗刹海市》《司文郎》《梦狼》《崂山道士》《促织》
modes.key_quote_zh: 花面逢迎，世情如鬼（《罗刹海市》）——规则颠倒的镜子照见的正是现实
modes.key_quote_en: "Painted faces fawn, and the ways of the world are ghostly (the Luocha Kingdom) — the mirror with rules reversed reflects reality itself"
process_zh: 锁定要批评的'规则'（而非事件）：审美标准、评审资格、职位性质——规则级批评比事件级批评寿命长
为规则造一个'整体颠倒'的世界：把该规则反着设（以丑为美、盲者衡文）——颠倒后的荒诞感是安全层也是放大镜
在颠倒世界里放一个'正常人'做对照组：马骥的俊、盲僧的明、成名的苦——正常人是读者在镜中的代理人
让读者自己完成'指认'：不给一句'此喻朝廷'——镜像与现实的相似度足以让指认自动发生，指认由读者做出即无把柄
process_en: Lock on the rule to criticize, not the event: standards of beauty, qualifications of judges, the nature of office — rule-level criticism outlives event-level
Build a world for the rule wholly inverted: set the rule backwards — ugliness prized, the blind judging — the absurdity of inversion is both shield and magnifier
Put one 'normal person' in the inverted world as control: Ma Ji's handsomeness, the monk's clarity, Cheng Ming's suffering — the normal one is the reader's agent in the mirror
Let the reader complete the identification: not one line saying 'this means the court' — the resemblance suffices to trigger it, and an identification made by the reader leaves no handle
representative_cases_zh: 《罗刹海市》的'涂脸得官'：马骥以煤涂面扮张飞即被拜官，洗净后众人避之——'美化装成丑'的动作把颠倒规则的运作机制完整演示一遍
《司文郎》的嗅文判定：盲僧'以鼻代目'评卷全中，放榜却尽落——颠倒的是'谁有资格评'，照出考官的不学
《梦狼》的白骨为馔：官僚世界里'堂上之虎以白骨为食'——把官职性质颠倒为食人，一句'官虎吏狼'完成制度判决
representative_cases_en: Painting the face for office in the Luocha tale: Ma Ji smears himself black as Zhang Fei and is promoted at once; washed clean, all flee him — the act of beautifying as ugliness demonstrates the inverted rule's whole mechanism
The nose as judge in Si Wen Lang: the blind monk's olfactory grading always right, yet all fail the exam — what is inverted is who may judge, lighting up the examiners' ignorance

White bones as fare in the wolf-dream: in the bureaucratic world the tiger on the seat feeds on bones — office inverted into cannibalism, one phrase 'tigers for officials, wolves for clerks' closing the institutional verdict
modern_applications_zh: 讽刺作品的'安全颠倒'技法：批评强环境时把规则整体移植到异质场景（架空国家、动物农场、外星球）——颠倒一层即安全一层
用'规则颠倒'做组织诊断工作坊：问'如果我们的评审标准反过来执行会怎样'——颠倒演练能暴露规则的真实后果
影射式内容创作：让颠倒世界的'正常人对照组'替读者完成自我指认——不说破的讽刺传播最远
modern_applications_en: The safe-inversion technique for satire: to criticize a hostile environment, transplant the rule whole into an alien scene — a fictional country, an animal farm, an alien planet; one layer of inversion, one layer of safety
Rule-inversion as an organizational diagnostic workshop: ask how our review standards would behave run backwards — the inversion drill exposes a rule's real consequences
Innuendo in content creation: let the inverted world's normal control figure complete the reader's self-recognition — satire left unsaid travels farthest

鲁迅（'吃人'一词对礼教的镜式翻译）

modes.name_en: The Method of Gathering from the Roads
modes.category: 方法论/以长期田野采集建构语料库
modes.domain_zh: 《聊斋自志》自述'才非干宝，雅爱搜神；情类黄州，喜人谈鬼。闻则命笔，遂以成编'——蒲松龄设茶烟于道旁，见行者过客，必强与语，搜奇说异（邹弢《三借庐笔谈》所记，虽经考辨存疑，而其'闻则命笔'的工作方式载于自志，确凿无疑）；他一生在毕家坐馆三十年，兼营柳泉、西铺间的收集网络。这个判断的深意在于：第一，语料库先于创作——'闻则命笔'是一套采集规程：听到即记录、积录成编——四百余篇不是灵感的堆叠，是三十年田野采集的沉积岩；第二，底层口述是独特信源——科举史料在官书里，而民间对科场、官府、市井的切身经验只在口头流传——他采集的正史不载的'活的制度经验'；第三，采集需要长期驻点与固定网络——三十年塾师生涯给他稳定的采集位置与叙事时间，柳泉设茶是把采集点制度化。他证明：一个领域的独特语料库，靠的是三十年如一日的定点采集，而非天才的灵光
modes.domain_en: His own preface confesses, 'my talent is not Gan Bao's, yet I love to gather the spirits; my temper is like Huangzhou's, I delight in men telling of ghosts; whatever I hear, I take up the brush, and so it has become a book' — the story goes that Pu set tea by the roadside at Liu Springs and pressed travelers to tell their strange tales (a story of Zou Tao's miscellany, disputed by scholars, while the working way of 'heard, then written' stands in his own preface beyond doubt); he tutored in the Bi household for thirty years, running his gathering network between Liu Springs and Xipu. The depth of the judgment: first, the corpus precedes the creation — 'heard, then written' is a protocol of collection: record on hearing, accumulate into a book — four hundred-odd tales are not a heap of inspirations but the sediment of thirty years of fieldwork; second, oral testimony from below is a unique source — the examination halls live in official records, but the people's lived experience of halls, yamen and streets exists only mouth to mouth — what he gathered was precisely the living institutional experience the official histories never carried; third, collection demands a long station and a fixed network — thirty years of tutoring gave him a stable post and narrative time, and the tea by the springs institutionalized the collection point. He proved: a field's unique corpus is built by thirty years of collection at a fixed point, not by flashes of genius
modes.source_chapter: 《聊斋自志》'闻则命笔，遂以成编'；毕家坐馆三十年；柳泉设茶采风传说
modes.key_quote_zh: 才非干宝，雅爱搜神；情类黄州，喜人谈鬼。闻则命笔，遂以成编（《聊斋自志》）
modes.key_quote_en: "My talent is not Gan Bao's, yet I love to gather the spirits; my temper is like Huangzhou's, I delight in men telling of ghosts; whatever I hear, I take up the brush, and so it became a book (the author's own preface)"
process_zh: 为你的领域定一个'别处没有的信源'：官方数据之外，找只在口头、一线、行业内流传的活经验——独特性来自信源选择
立一条'闻则命笔'的采集规程：听到即记录、当天成文、归档编号——采集的可靠性来自规程而非情绪
建立长期驻点与固定采集网络：三十年塾馆给蒲松龄位置与时间——你的'驻点'是什么（岗位、社区、行业群）要明确
把采集物整理成可检索的编目：以人物/题材/母题归档（狐、鬼、科场、公案）——语料库的价值在使用时的可提取性
process_en: Fix on a source your field lacks elsewhere: beyond official data, seek living experience that circulates only by word of mouth, on the front line, inside the trade — uniqueness comes from source selection
Establish a 'heard, then written' protocol: record on hearing, draft the same day, archive with numbering — reliability of collection comes from protocol, not mood
Build a long station and a fixed network: thirty years of tutoring gave Pu position and time — be clear what your station is: a post, a community, a trade group
Curate the collection into a retrievable catalog: file by figure, subject, motif — foxes, ghosts, halls, cases; a corpus is worth what its retrievability is worth at use
representative_cases_zh: 《聊斋自志》的采集纲领：'闻则命笔，遂以成编'八个字把写作重新定义为'记录的副产品'——先有采集系统，后有作品
柳泉设茶的制度化采集点：以茶换故事的'交易结构'让过客愿意停留——采集点的设计本身就是方法论
《聊斋》四百余篇的题材编目：狐（八十余篇）、鬼、科场、公案、动物——题材的聚类显示采集网络覆盖了民间叙事的全部主航道
representative_cases_en: The preface as a collection charter: 'heard, then written, and so a book' — eight characters redefine writing as the by-product of a recording system — first the collection apparatus, then the work
The tea by Liu Springs as an institutionalized point: a trade structure, tea for tales, that made travelers willing to stop — the design of the collection point is itself method

Four hundred tales cataloged by subject: foxes (eighty-odd tales), ghosts, examination halls, court cases, beasts — the clustering of subjects shows the gathering network covered every main channel of folk narrative
modern_applications_zh: 建立'一线语料库'：客服记录、销售录音、用户访谈——组织里最有价值的语料常在一线而非报表——立'闻则命笔'式的当天归档规程
长期驻点式研究：做行业知识库不靠一次调研，靠在行业里有一个持续驻点（岗位、社群）+ 三十年式的持续采集
以编目提高语料库价值：采集来的故事按母题/场景/教训归档——可提取性决定语料库是资产还是坟墓
modern_applications_en: Build a front-line corpus: support logs, sales calls, user interviews — an organization's most valuable corpus lives on the front line, not in the reports; set a same-day 'heard, then written' archiving rule
Station-based research over one-off surveys: an industry knowledge base comes not from a study but from a standing post in the industry plus years of unbroken collection
Cataloging makes the corpus an asset: file gathered stories by motif, scene, lesson — retrievability decides whether a corpus is an asset or a grave

modes.definition_en: His own preface confesses, 'my talent is not Gan Bao's, yet I love to gather the spirits; my temper is like Huangzhou's, I delight in men telling of ghosts; whatever I hear, I take up the brush, and so it has become a book' — the story goes that Pu set tea by the roadside at Liu Springs and pressed travelers to tell their strange tales (a story of Zou Tao's miscellany, disputed by scholars, while the working way of 'heard, then written' stands in his own preface beyond doubt); he tutored in the Bi household for thirty years, running his gathering network between Liu Springs and Xipu. The depth of the judgment: first, the corpus precedes the creation — 'heard, then written' is a protocol of collection: record on hearing, accumulate into a book — four hundred-odd tales are not a heap of inspirations but the sediment of thirty years of fieldwork; second, oral testimony from below is a unique source — the examination halls live in official records, but the people's lived experience of halls, yamen and streets exists only mouth to mouth — what he gathered was precisely the living institutional experience the official histories never carried; third, collection demands a long station and a fixed network — thirty years of tutoring gave him a stable post and narrative time, and the tea by the springs institutionalized the collection point. He proved: a field's unique corpus is built by thirty years of collection at a fixed point, not by flashes of genius

modes.name_en: The Method of Lodging Grief in the Brush
modes.category: 个人品格/以终身失意转译为传世之作
modes.domain_zh: 蒲松龄十九岁以县、府、道三试第一考中秀才，此后乡试四十四年间屡试屡败，七十一岁才援例得一个'岁贡生'的虚名；《聊斋自志》自道'集腋成裘，妄续幽冥之录；浮白载笔，仅成孤愤之书：寄托如此，亦足悲矣'——他把自己的终身失意明写为这本书的动力源。这个判断的深意在于：第一，失意被转化为书而非怨——同一块挫败的材料，可以发酵成牢骚，也可以铸成作品，他选了后者且明说'孤愤之书'——情绪被登记为方法论的一部分；第二，落第者的位置恰是批判者的位置——他一生站在科场门外，门外的视角让他看清门内的规则荒谬——'入闱七似'的刻毒只有屡败者写得出；第三，失意需要长时段的容器——三十年坐馆给了失意一个稳定的容器：白天教蒙童，夜里写狐鬼——日常秩序托住了失败的情绪，使它能持续产出而不溃散。他证明：人生最大的挫败可以被铸成最大的作品，条件是给它秩序、位置与三十年
modes.domain_en: At nineteen Pu Songling placed first in the county, the prefecture and the circuit examinations; for forty-four years after, he failed the provincial examination again and again, and at seventy-one received by grace the empty title of annual tribute scholar; his own preface says, 'gathering fluff to make a robe, I idly continue the record of the dark world; filling the cup and taking up the brush, I have only made a book of lonely indignation: to lodge so much in this — is it not sorrow' — he wrote his lifelong failure down as this book's power source. The depth of the judgment: first, failure was transmuted into a book, not a grievance — the same material of defeat can ferment into complaint or be cast into work; he chose the latter and named it plainly 'a book of lonely indignation' — emotion registered as part of the method; second, the failed candidate's position is exactly the critic's position — standing all his life outside the examination gate, the view from outside let him see the absurdity of the rules within — the venom of the 'seven likenesses' only a repeated failure could write; third, failure needs a long-spanned container — thirty years of tutoring gave failure a stable vessel: teaching children by day, writing foxes and ghosts by night — the order of the daily held the emotion of defeat so it could produce on and on instead of breaking down. He proved: a life's greatest defeat can be cast into its greatest work, given order, position, and thirty years

modes.key_quote_zh: 浮白载笔，仅成孤愤之书：寄托如此，亦足悲矣（《聊斋自志》）——失意被明写为动力源
modes.key_quote_en: "Filling the cup and taking up the brush, I have only made a book of lonely indignation: to lodge so much in this — is it not sorrow (the author's own preface) — failure written down openly as the power source"
process_zh: 把挫败登记为'创作资产'而非'人生污点'：明写失败（自志、序言、复盘）——被命名的失败才能被使用
认清'门外位置'的批判价值：被系统拒绝的人恰恰拿到了系统外视角——落第者写科场、被拒者写门槛，位置即资产
给失意建一个稳定容器：固定的日常秩序（职业、作息、场所）托住失败情绪——容器不稳，情绪溃散，产出中断
以三十年为尺度持续投入：不指望失败一次兑换一部杰作——失意之书是三十年的定期存款，非一日之愤
process_en: Register defeat as an asset of creation, not a stain of the life: write the failure down plainly — preface, memoir, review; a named failure can be used

Know the critical value of the outside position: one refused by the system is handed the view from outside it — the failed candidate writes the halls, the rejected writes the gate; the position is the asset
Build failure a stable container: a fixed order of days — work, hours, place — holds the emotion so it does not scatter; a broken container, a broken output
Invest on a thirty-year scale: do not expect one defeat to redeem one masterpiece — the book of indignation is a thirty-year deposit, not a day's rage
representative_cases_zh: 《聊斋自志》的自我定案：'孤愤之书'四字把终身挫败正式登记为作品的著作权人——失败被授予署名权
'入闱七似'的门外刻毒：四十四年落第换来的不是怨言而是一份对科场心理的精确解剖——只有场外人写得出场内的每一步失态
三十年坐馆的'白天/黑夜'双轨制：白天教书糊口维持秩序，夜里著书承载孤愤——日常与志业的分工让失意可持续运转
representative_cases_en: The preface's self-verdict: the four characters 'a book of lonely indignation' formally register lifelong defeat as the work's copyright holder — failure granted the right of signature

The outside venom of the seven likenesses: forty-four years of failing returned not complaint but a precise anatomy of the candidate's mind — only one outside the walls could write every faltering step within
The day-and-night double track of thirty years' tutoring: teaching for bread kept the order, night writing carried the indignation — the division of daily life and vocation made failure sustainable
modern_applications_zh: 把被拒经历转化为专业资格：被大厂拒、被期刊拒、被评审拒的人，恰恰拥有'门外解剖'的独家视角——把它写成方法论而非抱怨
为长期项目建立'失意容器'：副业、转行、写作都需一份稳定主业/作息托底——先解决容器，再解决产出
公开命名自己的'孤愤'：把挫败写进项目自述（如开源项目的发轫文档）——被命名的动机自带叙事可信度
modern_applications_en: Convert rejection into professional qualification: one refused by the great firm, the journal, the panel holds the exclusive outside view — write it as method, not complaint
Build every long project a container of failure: a side venture, a career switch, a book all need a stable base of work and hours — settle the container before the output
Name your indignation in public: write the defeat into the project's own preface, as founding documents of open-source projects do — a named motive carries its own credibility
